notes.title: 2024 Update Plan
notes.content:
[h2][b]Thank you all for your support![/b]The game has been steadily updated for a year now, and we will continue to do so in the coming year. We also appreciate the players who have provided us with suggestions. We have compiled all the suggestions and developed an update plan.[/h2]



[h3]Vehicle[/h3]
Performance optimization: In response to the most criticized vehicle issues by players, in mid-2024, we will optimize the collision performance and physical effects of vehicles to make them more like real-life vehicles rather than toy cars. Optimize operability to better control the steering of the entire vehicle even at high speeds.

[b]System refactoring:[/b]The vehicles seen in games nowadays are all complete individuals, even if they are destroyed by zombies, they are still intact. However, in movies, vehicle vehicles are often more susceptible to being destroyed by zombies and are more prone to missing components. In our original concept, the vehicle should not be a complete individual, but rather fragmented and composed of multiple components. In future updates, we will reconstruct the vehicle system, which will consist of multiple components, making it difficult for players to find complete individuals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/86d66dffb46ac9d6000c066d790351b84922cb1f.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay addition:[/b]In terms of vehicle gameplay, in future updates, we will introduce a modification gameplay for vehicles. You can modify multiple components of the vehicle to improve one aspect. This modification is reversible and can be freely modified according to personal preferences, such as color, engine, tires, etc., to create your own unique style of modification.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/0cfeae0e325771b308c505001974beb80c2fadec.png[/img]

[b]New vehicle:[/b]There are too few vehicles now! This is not in line with reality. In cities, there will not be only pickup trucks and sedans, people will not only use these two types of cars, nor will there be people who only use gasoline cars. In future updates, we will launch multiple vehicles including special police jeeps, police cars, transport trucks, and human powered tricycles. Among them, special vehicles have better practicality but also come with huge risks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/08d7ad7a643854bad118e89c3bfec14e97bb2569.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/26b8d6ac1e8707aa0b994fc3a068c16ed3912a5b.png[/img]

[h3]weapon[/h3]
[b]Gameplay reconstruction:[/b]In response to the weapon modification gameplay criticized by players, in the new follow-up updates, we will optimize the entire weapon modification system, optimize the UI display of weapon modification, so that players can see more clearly the changes and improvements brought by weapon modification accessories. Increasing the number and types of modified components, some special modified accessories not only bring significant benefits to a certain attribute, but also limit certain functions and operations of the weapon, making it a full double-edged sword. These newly added firearm accessories not only allow players to modify their existing muzzle, magazine, and sight, but also give them the possibility to modify other components. We will determine the possibility of modifying melee weapons based on feedback levels in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/0a6af60bc05b799bbff70cd518073c86e233f2ca.png[/img]

[b]New weapon:[/b]In future updates, we will introduce more distinctive weapon types, such as revolvers, assault pistols, Origin-12 shotguns, P90, DBS shotguns, chainsaws, samurai knives, etc
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/4b75b4e416aad20dd8bdf37e5660dc01e01bee11.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/f96bf3b8ba7f28797b6c3f2aa7b2fae03dd8218b.png[/img]

[h3]Character model[/h3]
[b]High definition reset of character models:[/b]Based on the character model issues mentioned by players, in the 2024 update, we will optimize the character model to achieve better visual representation in terms of body proportions, muscle texture, and skin texture. In response to the problem of stiff facial expressions and hollow eyes of game characters, we will redraw their faces to make them closer to the real face direction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/08df9d8befbd9b30341c12a4ca980b5c2e8e18e0.png[/img]


[h3]clothing and other articles of daily use[/h3]
[b]HD reset:[/b]In response to the material issue of clothing, in mid-2024, we will reset all existing clothing in the game in high-definition to make the material more high-definition and refined, reduce the edges of the clothing model, and make the clothing model more lubricating.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/ba9bb71ac01d64d6d051fec83e248dbb96f24a6a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/b8e934af0707a0e55d21e37e74f90cadaddf631f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/bced9baa08b85cf32ec8ee22a7544d745c0b3ade.png[/img]

[b]New clothing:[/b]In mid-2024, we will launch new clothing that will be more distinctive, some of which will have additional backpack compartments, but the difficulty of obtaining these clothes will be greater and they will be rarer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/9ef8b984981425498028d413262107a144dfa2a2.png[/img]


[h3]Pain system[/h3]
In the current game, players only have two types of injury states: infection and bleeding, which is not in line with our expectations. In future updates, we will add a pain system that divides the player's body into the head, torso, and limbs. After being hit and damaged in different parts, players will be given abnormal states such as fractures, pain, spasms, etc., making the game more realistic. Players need to use newly added drugs to treat themselves and eliminate negative effects.

[h3]properties system[/h3]
In future updates, additional attributes such as strength, agility, and skill will be added to the body display field, which will affect the player's character's melee, bow and arrow damage, and weight bearing; Change speed, movement speed; Collection efficiency and production speed. Enable players to better experience game content, with the goal of enhancing game characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/5c31839c00ba23c8843fc0cf82d7584bcdd9d6e2.png[/img]

[h3]NPC behavior optimization[/h3]
The NPC behavior in the game is too mechanical and wooden, which does not meet our initial design expectations. In future updates, we will optimize their behavior and logic, making them more intelligent and more like living people. The current number of NPCs is really too small. If the end of the world really erupts and there are only a few survivors, it would be sad for players. In future updates, we will introduce more unique NPCs to enrich the player's experience in the game.

[h3]New tasks[/h3]
In the current game content, the task system is too single in terms of rewards and types, which is not what we expected. In future updates, we will add new task types and rewards to enrich the gameplay of this system and increase the proportion of the task system.

[h3]organism[/h3]
[b]New Animals: [/b]For players who want pets to accompany them, we believe that having a pet companion in a depressed post apocalyptic life is a good idea to soothe their mood. So in future updates, players can find new animals in the game map, which can become our means of transportation, new dangers, and even our animal companions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/50951a5d2bb21f0e63e7ad6b75a122d6a5f99ff0.png[/img]

[b]Cultivation:[/b]Players can cultivate some of the updated animals, select excellent genes, and cultivate offspring with faster speed and weight bearing ability. We believe this is a great idea, who wouldn't want to be an animal breeder in the apocalypse. In future updates, we will introduce more animals for players to cultivate based on the evaluation of this gameplay.

[h3]Occupational system and characteristics[/h3]
[b]Occupation:[/b]We believe that the people who survived the apocalypse should have different characteristics and abilities. They may include scholars, police officers, workers, etc. These people should use different resources around them to make weapons in the event of the apocalypse. Therefore, in order to enrich the gameplay, we will allow players to choose their own characters' professions, which will improve their skills in the early stages of the game, There are certain differences between equipment and post game battles in base construction.

[b]Features:[/b]
The current character characteristics and gameplay have a low proportion in the player's gameplay, which is not in line with our design expectations. In the future, we will go back and optimize the gameplay of the features, changing the original random acquisition method to autonomous selection, no longer limited to fixed combinations with the same number of additions and subtractions, and adding more character features to adapt to this change. Enable players to match their own Doomsday Survival Masters based on their gameplay strategies and interests.

[h3]new map[/h3]
In the 2024 update plan, we will launch a brand new map with new environmental landforms, ecological environment, and gameplay. The new map will have better targeting compared to the old map. The new map will be divided into different difficult blocks, and the closer it is to the central map, the richer the resources, and the greater the threat it brings. The layout of urban houses will also be more compact and standardized, with many iconic buildings and basic public facilities in this new city. The wilderness is no longer empty and monotonous, with scattered villages and crisis servo military facilities and dungeons. New NPCs, missions, and monsters will appear in the new map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/45189de02148f8262ad88e9f10e7855922c6ace9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/a5042171a28951e27d966c39d9ebe4a3eb80ec00.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/e426373e44fa72bcfbaab13dd5d48c2cd96e9431.png[/img]
[h3]New furniture and building structures[/h3]
In the new year's update, we will update more themed furniture with more festive characteristics in some festival activities. This part of the content will be fully open to players after the update and will not disappear due to the end of the festival. In addition, we will continue to introduce more base decorations, such as statues, decorations, and furniture, for players to build their own survivor camps. For architectural construction, we will introduce features such as garage rolling doors, glass doors, 3/4 ceilings, 1/2 ceilings, and fences made of different materials to enrich the construction gameplay and improve the construction experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/5b087e06efe3679405dc413f0c7cf9d0576f88db.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/0c4afc2790609ab912ec951fe3801395ed15b731.png[/img]

[h3]Optimize enemy logic and behavior[/h3]
In the new map, wandering corpses and bandit hunters searching everywhere will appear. These newly added mechanics and gameplay will bring a unique gaming experience to the new map, and players can choose to let it go, making it a potential threat to the camp; You can also surround and clean them up, but this may put you and your team in danger.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/4acb391d4daad7675fc5c7bfc67c586b5ffbf03d.png[/img]

[h3]function optimization[/h3]
In response to the death instructions, direction instructions, map markers and other functions that players often talk about, they will be optimized and solved in future updates by adding some special items. Players can obtain these special items through search, missions, and NPC transactions in the game. By equipping different special items, these problems can be solved.

notes.title: Deployment instructions for Windows Server dedicated servers
notes.content:
[h2]Dedicated servers use SteamCMD to complete deployment[/h2]
[b]SteamCDM Official User Tutorial:[/b]
[url=https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/SteamCMD]https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/SteamCMD[/url]

Server AppID:[b]2329680[/b]
[b]If the server cannot run, you can try installing the running environment[/b]
[url=https://1drv.ms/u/s!AhvGbZ0VZWm3gglwUylsUSxEHkg8?e=UdMkfX]https://1drv.ms/u/s!AhvGbZ0VZWm3gglwUylsUSxEHkg8?e=UdMkfX[/url]


[b]Remote Desktop Login to Windows Server[/b]
[h3]1. Create a folder, download SteamCMD and unzip it, double-click to run SteamCMd.exe[/h3]
Download address:[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd.zip]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd.zip[/url]

[h3]2. Open steamcmd.exe and enter login account password[/h3]

[h3]3. After logging in, enter the app_update 2329680 validate deployment server, waiting for deployment to complete[/h3]

[h3]4. Create a server configuration file[/h3]
Create the Game.ini file (this is a text file) under .\steamapps\common\NoOneSurvivedServer\WRSH\Saved\Config\WindowsServer\ or download [url=https://1drv.ms/u/s!AhvGbZ0VZWm3ggcOis6XuPRmtY3y?e=MxanRv]it[/url] here
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/13bd97f89e732c30321a51408dde03e7c0454dbe.png[/img]

Server parameter configuration instructions:
[ServerSetting]
SaveName：The name of the archive, which is also the default archive to be loaded.
ServerName：Indicates the name of the searched server
OpenMap：Map01 is a large map Map02 is a small map
NeedPassword：True means the server requires a password, False means no password is required
Password：Password required to enter the server
MaxPlayers：Maximum number of people in the server (2-50)
NumOfZombieSpawn：The number of zombies generated in one wave of zombies (25-100)
Region：Server region setting, All means no registration area, AF means Africa, AS means Asia, EU means Europe, NA means North America, OC means Oceania, SA means South America.
AdminPassword：Server administrator password

[GameSettings]
ZombieAttack：Whether to turn on zombie tide
GiftBagForNovices：Whether to open the novice gift package
ZombieAttackDay：Zombie Tide Attack Day (1-30)
AttackZombieNum：Attack zombie tide size (1-5)
ZombieNum：Number of lost spawns on the map (1-3)
RunZombiePercent：Percentage of running corpses (0.0-1.0)
ZombieStreng：Zombie strength (0-3)
YearDay：A year's time
PermanentDead：Whether to enable permanent death
MaterialNum：Material quantity (0-3)
ItemSpawn：Material refresh date
VirusFatalityRate：Virus fatality rate (0.0-1.0)
NPCItemSpawn：Merchant item refresh date
PVP：False means PVE mode, True means PVP mode
DayLength:The length of a day, in minutes (only allowed at 45, 90120)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/4172610f208818648d400507e5da3efbe0ee2421.png[/img]

[h3]5. Start the server through .\steamapps\common\NoOneSurvivedServer\StartServer.bat[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/8386e65bef9d12f2e46921c53c9def70cc5bc04e.png[/img]

When the server window displays ServerCreate, it means the server has started successfully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/1fc8ee8eb136245828d59cfddf70cf1c6df7746c.png[/img]

[h3]6. The update server can start the update through UpdateServer.bat[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/dbdc05f33cec4d74ca730c46186efa049650c01b.png[/img]

[h3]7. It is recommended to open all UDP and TCP ports of the server[/h3]


Server configuration recommendations:
For a 64 square kilometer map, at least 8G of memory is recommended, 16G is best
For a map of 16 square kilometers, at least 4G memory is recommended, 8G is best

If the memory is not enough, you can increase the virtual memory

It is recommended that the minimum version of the server is Windows 2016 Server or above. Otherwise, a function will report an error, but it will not affect the operation of the server.

notes.title: Announcement of future update plan
notes.content:
First of all, I would like to thank all the players for their feedback, suggestions, error reports and support. Without all this, our game might disappear in Steam.

Whether it's Steam Forum, Discord, Steam comments, suggestions sent by QQ, etc., we have all checked your comments, but because of time constraints, we haven't replied to every one. I'm sorry.

Based on all the players' suggestions, we have determined our long-term update plan.

Statistical table:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/ef53c61ed80d8081f20387b3cd4dfd8c9b68d6f1.png[/img]

[h2]Here are our plans for new content in the future:[/h2]
[h3][b]1. Friendly NPC[/b][/h3]
Players can build a doomsday shelter, recruit NPC to help work and collect resources.
As for how to recruit NPC and NPC's daily needs, we still need to plan in depth, and there may be bandits against NPC.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/71e9e72ba40971426370ec7c2a17d5cc1249e7b2.png[/img]

[h3][b]2. First person mode[/b][/h3]
You can switch between the third person and the first person.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/d329cbd303119419d22516289f5acbd006b11be3.png[/img]

[h3][b]3. Dedicated server[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]4. More traps[/b][/h3]
Design more traps to resist the tide of corpses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/dd0b3cdd9cd5f2427806c83a4aae18fc37f4eeb3.png[/img]

[h3][b]5. More firearms[/b][/h3]
Various firearms have been in our plan. As long as we have more time, we will add firearms to the game.
Now we most want to add a gun with a large capacity similar to M249.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/16319e828d69f7b3c33162457005802807d9bd8a.png[/img]

[h3][b]6. More special infected persons[/b][/h3]
For special infected persons, our plan is to add infected persons with long-range attack, self-explosive type, strong but slow attack and high attack speed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/9a68dfd5fa997e7af5db6f70631bb87536f08711.png[/img]

[h3][b]7. More house decorations and buildings[/b][/h3]
For example: wardrobe, potted plants, fireplace, electric heater
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/629fb79b9f32055712b5cbf94f398499f62dee36.png[/img]

[h3][b]8. Task system[/b][/h3]
We haven't figured out how to do this yet. It may also be that after killing the special infected person or ordinary zombie, you can find a merchant to receive rewards, or destroy the bandit camp, etc.

[h3][b]9. More vehicles and modifications[/b][/h3]
We hope that each vehicle has some different characteristics, such as high durability of trucks or all-terrain vehicles, large space capacity, but slow speed.
More durability and storage space can be obtained after vehicle modification.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/34a9e3f8d9f24a0f52191d020ca7d9acee78c3e7.png[/img]

[h3][b]10. More colorful clothing[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/c6b131ce8e8a1f96e0b70ba919f9cb102282fa43.png[/img]

[h3][b]11. Fishing system[/b][/h3]


[h3]improvement:[/h3]
[b]1. Better action design
2. Improve translation. Many players in the community have made great contributions to translation. We are very grateful. Translation will be better in the future.
3. Screen and map optimization[/b]

Finally, we will be very busy next, so I won't often interact with you in the community. Please forgive me.

Thank you very much for your support. I hope you and I are full of expectations for the future of this game!

Improved untranslated content

Thank you for helping us correct the translation of French and Portuguese

Add Turkish support

Add Hungarian support

Add adjustable FOV in screen setting

Client search is optimized, and the UI cannot be closed when clicking too fast

Adjust the character's default weight to 65

Fix the bug that the merchant relationship is not saved after exiting the game

Add window full-screen support

Add 5120x1440 resolution support

You can't hold the trailer while squatting, and repair the trailer that has been knocked off when squatting

Fix that if you die when you unlock, the unlock screen will remain on the interface

Fix the bug that cannot be recovered from automatic archive if the file has never been saved

Modify the auto save to overwrite the main archive

A force will be applied when the zombie is removed

Optimization In the case of non-Chinese, the display of vehicle fuel loss is incomplete

Repair some places in the map that wear models

Add an option to display teammate ID, which can be enabled in screen settings

The new map will show the position of teammates

Optimization of disengaging function

Reduce the amount of ore required for smelting metal block

Reduce the weight of ore

Increased interaction distance between rainwater collectors

One log can now produce three charcoal

Reduce the demand for construction logs

Increase the durability of weapons and tools

Reduce carbon, water, protein and water consumed by fast running

notes.title: 0.0.2.8 Update description
notes.content:
Fix the problem of file reading failure caused by

Add the novice gift package, and open the novice gift package by default

Decreases the life of climbers

Reduce the weight of cloth

Maximum frame rate lock repair

Now a game archive name will be generated by default

It reduces the materials required for construction of some buildings and reduces the manufacturing time of some items

Increase the output of wood boards made from logs

If you hold the construction hammer in hand, you will ignore the interaction with the water, so it is convenient to build in the water

Fixed the error of clients climbing vertical stairs at the cruise ship

Optimize the running of characters. Sometimes the client will get stuck

There is a chance that the repair will cause the search box to be unable to interact

Adjust the default difficulty to leisure mode

Slightly reduce canned output

Improve the storage time of prepared dishes

Repair the air wall found on the map

Added a brightness adjustment setting

Optimization may cause problems with invisible zombies

Modify the length of the item prompt to better adapt to multiple languages

Optimize the possibility of being pushed to the sky when using the trolley

notes.title: 0.0.2.7 Update description
notes.content:
Repair the problem of the sound of disassembly if you die when disassembling items

Increase the probability of producing pots in places where can can be produced

Optimize car sound range

Repair some unreasonable places on the map

Reduce running endurance consumption

Increase box interaction distance

Small trees and stones disappear faster

Optimize the sound of objects

Optimize the physical effects of zombie death

Fix client zombie model offset error in multiplayer mode

Add game archive recovery. You can choose to restore your archive in the loading interface (we hope you never use this function)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/3c17fb43d52f4a56803e124bb70823ad3994885e.png[/img]

Add a button to save the game in the exit menu (only visible to the host)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271927/2b1a6871aca81bacd9d0158c446fc7ae1869448f.png[/img]

In version 0.0.2.5, a small number of players have died of archive necrosis. We are very sorry. We have actually repaired bugs in version 0.0.2.6, but we still feel insecure. In version 0.0.2.7, we added the file return function, which can restore the archive from the automatic saving of history.

I hope to get your tolerance!

We are very sorry!
